+        self._endpoint_context: Optional[dict] = None
+
+    def _get_endpoint_context(self) -> Optional[dict]:
+        if self._endpoint_context is not None:
+            return self._endpoint_context
+        context = self._extract_endpoint_context()
+        self._endpoint_context = context
+        return context
+
+    def _extract_endpoint_context(self) -> Optional[dict]:
+        exc_type, exc_value, exc_trace = sys.exc_info()
+        if exc_type is not type(self) and exc_type is not None:
+            return None
+        
+        context: dict = {}
+        for frame in exc_trace:
+            if isinstance(frame.f_code, (type(lambda: None), type(object())):
+                continue
+            
+            file_path = frame.f_code.co_filename
+            line = frame.f_lineno
+            func = frame.f_code.co_name
+            
+            try:
+                frame_obj = frame.f_back
+                if frame_obj is None:
+                    continue
+                
+                # Get request/websocket object to extract route/method
+                if hasattr(frame_obj, "request"):
+                    req: Any = frame_obj.request
+                    if hasattr(req, "scope"):
+                        scope: Dict[str, Any] = req.scope
+                        path = scope.get("path", "")
+                        method = scope.get("method", "")
+                        context["route"] = f"{method} {path}"
+                
+                context["file"] = file_path
+                context["line"] = line
+                context["function"] = func
+        return context
 
     def errors(self) -> Sequence[Any]:
         return self._errors
